legal_privacy_meta: Privacy Policy for {{hotelName}} — what data we collect at booking, how it is used, and your GDPR rights.
legal_privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy describes what personal data {{hotelName}} collects when you make a booking request, how it is used, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We keep things minimal — we collect only what is strictly necessary to process your reservation.
legal_privacy_s1_body: When you submit a booking request you provide your name, phone number, and optionally your email address. We collect only these fields — nothing more. We do not use cookies, analytics scripts, or tracking pixels of our own on this website.
legal_privacy_s2_body: Your data is used solely to process your booking request: a notification with your booking details is sent to the hotel by email, and if you opt in, a confirmation email is sent to you. Your data is not used for marketing, profiling, or any other purpose.
legal_privacy_s3_body: We process your personal data on the basis of Article 6(1)(b) GDPR — processing is necessary to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract (your booking reservation). No separate consent is required for this processing.
legal_privacy_s4_body: Booking requests are handled by a Cloudflare Worker (Cloudflare Inc., US — data transfers covered by Standard Contractual Clauses). Notification and confirmation emails are sent via Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France — EU-based processor with a GDPR-compliant data processing agreement). We do not share your data with any other third party and we never sell it.
legal_privacy_s5_body: We do not store your personal data in any database on our side. Your data exists only in the email notification received by the hotel and, if you requested it, in the confirmation email sent to you. No booking records are retained on our servers after the emails are dispatched.
legal_privacy_s6_body: This website embeds a Google Maps widget to display the hotel location. When the map loads, Google LLC (US) may collect technical data such as your IP address and browser information under Google's own Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy). This processing is carried out by Google under their own terms and is separate from Firmizo's data practices.
legal_privacy_s7_body: This website does not use any cookies, analytics scripts, or advertising pixels of its own. The only third-party component that may set cookies is the embedded Google Maps widget, which is governed by Google's privacy and cookie policies. Because we do not use consent-based processing, no cookie consent banner is required.
legal_privacy_s8_body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or port your personal data, and to object to its processing. Since we do not retain data ourselves, requests can be directed to the hotel at {{email}}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian Data Protection Authority (ANSPDCP) at www.dataprotection.ro.
legal_privacy_s9_body: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your data rights, email us at {{email}} or use the contact details in the footer of this website.
legal_terms_meta: Terms of Service for {{hotelName}} — rules and conditions for using our website and booking services.
legal_terms_intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the {{hotelName}} website and booking services. By submitting a booking request, you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms.
legal_terms_s1_body: By accessing this website or submitting a booking request, you confirm that you have read and agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.
legal_terms_s2_body: Submitting a booking request does not guarantee a reservation. All bookings are subject to availability and require confirmation from the hotel. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel reservations that violate our policies or applicable law.
legal_terms_s3_body: Cancellation and modification terms depend on the rate plan shown at booking and are confirmed by the hotel after your request is accepted. No payment is collected through this website. To cancel or change a booking, contact the hotel directly using the details provided in your confirmation.
legal_terms_s4_body: Guests are responsible for providing accurate booking information, complying with house rules, and respecting the property and other guests during their stay.
legal_terms_s5_body: To the extent permitted by law, {{hotelName}} is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of this website or your stay, except where liability cannot be excluded.
legal_terms_s6_body: This website does not use cookies or analytics tracking of its own. The only third-party component that may set cookies is the embedded Google Maps widget in the location section, which operates under Google's own privacy and cookie policies.
legal_terms_s7_body: For questions about these terms, please contact us using the information provided on our website.
